advancement.hc_characters.story.first_me: You found an unknown girl in the clearing.
advancement.hc_characters.story.first_tr: She seems a little calmer around you.
advancement.hc_characters.story.player_h: Polen believes this shelter could be a new beginning.
dialogue.hc_characters.common.relationsh: There is nothing else to say right now.
dialogue.lucy.scene.after_discovery.line: Well, that's done. I can stop passing sketches around the whole village now.
dialogue.lucy.scene.ambient.lucy.1: A girl. In the clearing past the village. She kept slipping behind the flowers, and every time I thought she'd gone, I saw her again.
dialogue.lucy.scene.ambient.lucy.2: That's why I drew the sketch first. I didn't want to talk myself into thinking I'd imagined her.
dialogue.lucy.scene.ambient.soa.1: Easy, Lucy. Start from the beginning. What did you see?
dialogue.lucy.scene.ambient.soa.2: Alright. Then nobody runs at her. If someone goes, they go quietly and let the girl choose the distance.
dialogue.lucy.scene.clue.line1: I saw a girl alone in a clearing nearby.
dialogue.lucy.scene.clue.line2: She didn't look hurt, and she didn't look lost either. More like... careful. Like she was watching everything around her.
dialogue.lucy.scene.clue.line3: Do not go to her like a rescuer. Approach slowly, look first, and give her room.
dialogue.lucy.scene.clue.line4: Here. Take the sketch. It'll help you find the place.
dialogue.lucy.scene.clue.received: Lucy presses the sketch into your hand while SoaMarjorie makes the warning unmistakably clear with one steady look.
dialogue.lucy.scene.repeat.line1: You already have the sketch. Just go carefully and don't frighten her.
dialogue.lucy.scene.replacement.line1: You lost the sketch? Hm. Good thing I made another.
dialogue.lucy.scene.replacement.line2: And this time, listen to SoaMarjorie: no noise, no rushing.
dialogue.lucy.scene.soa_intro.line1: Lucy doesn't rattle this easily. If she's this unsettled, then she saw something real.
dialogue.lucy.scene.soa_intro.line2: Go if you must, but do it gently. Do not corner the girl.
dialogue.lucy.scene.soa_repeat.line1: The important part has not changed: calm, respect, and open eyes.
dialogue.polen.ambient_approach.warm.lin: Polen steps closer without making a sound.
Polen moves nearer with a shy smile.
dialogue.polen.ambient_bedtime.guarded.l: That is enough for today. I am staying here.
This bed will do. I do not want to keep moving.
I will head back out when morning comes.
dialogue.polen.ambient_bedtime.soft.line: Alright... I am staying here tonight.
This corner feels like mine for a little while.
I can rest calmly with this bed here.
dialogue.polen.ambient_bedtime.warm.line: I made it back to my bed. I feel better now.
Good night... I am staying here.
This refuge is enough to carry me through the night.
These flowers have something special about them. They are not here by accident.
Flowers change the mood of a place faster than stone ever does.
If a bee stops here, there is probably a reason.
dialogue.polen.ambient_curiosity.guarded: These flowers... they look different up close.
Bees notice things most people never see.
There is something here that feels familiar.
dialogue.polen.ambient_curiosity.hive.li: Hives always say more than they seem to from the outside.
I could watch a hive for a long time without getting tired of it.
There is order, labor, and memory in something that small.
dialogue.polen.ambient_curiosity.soft.li: I feel like I have seen something like this before.
Sometimes a hive says more than an entire book.
The more I look, the more questions I want to ask.
dialogue.polen.ambient_curiosity.warm.li: Look at the way they move... as if they always know where to go.
I could stay here watching them for a long time.
I like it when something small can still surprise me.
dialogue.polen.ambient_drawing.guarded.l: Oh... I was only drawing a little.
It is nothing important. Just a few lines.
Sometimes drawing helps me sort my thoughts.
dialogue.polen.ambient_drawing.soft.line: I wanted to remember this shape before I forgot it.
If I draw it, it feels like it stays with me a little longer.
I do not always understand what I remember... but I can draw it.
dialogue.polen.ambient_drawing.warm.line: Maybe I will show you this sketch later.
I like drawing things when the day has been kind.
I wanted to keep this moment before it passed.
dialogue.polen.ambient_illumination.emer: I need light now, before this closes in any further.
A little light can interrupt their advance. Give me a second.
If I light this spot, we can breathe again.
dialogue.polen.ambient_illumination.guar: This corner is too dim. I can fix that for a while.
I would rather not stay in the dark if I can help it.
A small light is enough. I do not need anything grand.
dialogue.polen.ambient_illumination.sett: That is better. The light is holding this corner together now.
With this lantern burning, the place finally stops feeling empty.
A quiet light changes more than it seems to.
dialogue.polen.ambient_illumination.soft: Let me leave a little light here. It feels better this way.
If the place can breathe, I can breathe too.
A quiet light makes a place feel less abandoned.
dialogue.polen.ambient_illumination.warm: There... that should make this place kinder.
I like when a dark corner starts feeling lived in.
It is only a lantern, but it changes the whole mood.
dialogue.polen.ambient_magic.attuning.li: If I stay still a little longer, I can tune this thread properly.
It is not ready yet, but it is almost in rhythm.
I am only adjusting the magic so it does not scatter.
dialogue.polen.ambient_magic.guarded.lin: It is nothing... only a thread of magic.
Sometimes the runes answer when I stay still.
I did not mean to startle you. I can still do small things.
dialogue.polen.ambient_magic.soft.line1: When everything is calm, source listens to me a little better.
dialogue.polen.ambient_magic.soft.line2: Jeff used to say healing was not erasing a wound, but convincing the body to try again.
dialogue.polen.ambient_magic.soft.line3: Magic remembers some things before I do.
dialogue.polen.ambient_magic.source.line: Something here is answering the magic. I can feel it clearly.
This place gives the pulse of magic back, as if it were listening.
When magic settles like this, I want to follow it.
dialogue.polen.ambient_magic.warm.line1: Look... only a spark. It will not hurt anything.
dialogue.polen.ambient_magic.warm.line2: Vanilla would have corrected my stance... and then pretended she was not proud.
dialogue.polen.ambient_magic.warm.line3: Sometimes I sing or draw, and the air answers back.
dialogue.polen.ambient_night_house.guard: I will spend the night inside this house.
In here I can stay calm until morning.
This house will do for the night.
I think I will spend the night in here.
With a roof and light nearby, this place convinces me.
I can truly rest here until dawn.
I will spend the night here with you, inside this house.
I like this place for waiting until sunrise.
Inside this house, the night feels far less harsh.
dialogue.polen.ambient_night_roof.guarde: I will spend the night under this roof if I must.
It is not much, but this roof is enough to stay.
As long as I stay covered, I can pass the night here.
dialogue.polen.ambient_night_roof.soft.l: I think I will spend the night in this shelter.
This roof is enough. I only need a safe corner.
Night feels lighter once I find a roof.
dialogue.polen.ambient_night_roof.warm.l: I will spend the night here with you, under this roof.
This shelter is not bad for waiting until day.
With a roof and a little calm, the night becomes bearable.
dialogue.polen.ambient_night_tree.guarde: I may spend the night here, under this tree, if nothing gets worse.
It is not the best place, but I can stay here for now.
This shade will do for a little while longer.
dialogue.polen.ambient_night_tree.soft.l: I think I will spend the night here, under the branches.
This tree is enough for now. I only need some calm.
If we stay here, I can make the night feel a little gentler.
dialogue.polen.ambient_night_tree.warm.l: I will spend the night here with you, under this tree.
It is not a house, but this tree still feels safe.
We can stay here until daylight comes back.
dialogue.polen.ambient_rain_house.guarde: I will wait out the rain inside this house.
It feels better in here. I will stay under this roof.
I do not want to get soaked again. This house will do.
dialogue.polen.ambient_rain_house.soft.l: This house will work. I will wait for the rain in here.
With walls and a roof, it is easier to think calmly.
The rain cannot reach us here. We can stay a little.
dialogue.polen.ambient_rain_house.warm.l: I will wait with you inside this house until the rain passes.
I like this shelter better. It feels lived in.
Under this roof, everything already feels kinder.
dialogue.polen.ambient_rain_roof.guarded: I will stay under this roof until the rain eases.
It is not a house, but this roof will do.
As long as it keeps the rain off us, it is enough.
dialogue.polen.ambient_rain_roof.soft.li: This little roof is enough for now.
Rain reminds me of Noia and Noris studying late, as if the world could wait until the next exam.
The rain feels lighter once I stand here.
dialogue.polen.ambient_rain_roof.warm.li: We will stay under this roof until it calms down.
It is not so bad. This corner protects us.
With this roof above us, I already feel better.
dialogue.polen.ambient_rain_tree.guarded: I will wait out the rain under this tree.
It does not fall as hard here. I can stay a moment.
The leaves are enough for now. I do not want to move too much.
dialogue.polen.ambient_rain_tree.soft.li: This tree covers us well enough. I will wait here.
I can breathe better under the branches. Let it pass.
It is not perfect, but this tree works as shelter.
dialogue.polen.ambient_rain_tree.warm.li: I will wait with you under this tree until it eases.
We are fairly safe here. The rain can keep going for a while.
This tree feels kind enough to wait beneath together.
dialogue.polen.ambient_reflection.guarde: I only wanted a quiet moment to think.
When it is calm enough, my thoughts stop running.
dialogue.polen.ambient_reflection.home.l: I can lower my guard a little here. It feels close to coming home.
This is more than rest. A place like this can actually hold me together.
When I find a corner like this, my thoughts finally stop running.
dialogue.polen.ambient_reflection.return: I want to go back to the place where I know I can rest.
I am not there yet, but I am already thinking about the way back.
Sometimes all I need is to return to my place.
dialogue.polen.ambient_reflection.soft.l: Sometimes I need to sit with a feeling before I understand it.
Sometimes I think about Luna. Her light did not really go out; it only changed places.
I do not always need answers. Sometimes I only need stillness.
dialogue.polen.ambient_reflection.warm.l: This place feels gentle enough to stay a while.
I like moments like this... when nothing is demanding anything from us.
A soft light and a safe place can do a lot for the heart.
dialogue.polen.ambient_singing.guarded.l: Sorry... I did not mean to make noise.
I was only humming. I can stop.
Sometimes I start singing without noticing...
dialogue.polen.ambient_singing.soft.line: I could not remember the whole song... only this part.
When everything is calm, it comes back on its own.
dialogue.polen.ambient_singing.warm.line: Do not laugh... I really like this part.
It feels less strange to sing when you are nearby.
This place sounds different when it is peaceful.
dialogue.polen.ambient_timid.guarded.lin: Sorry... I need a little space.
It is nothing personal. Just... too close.
I would rather speak when I can breathe a little.
dialogue.polen.ambient_timid.soft.line1: Give me a second... I am alright.
dialogue.polen.ambient_timid.soft.line2: It still startles me when someone appears so suddenly.
dialogue.polen.ambient_timid.soft.line3: I do not want to leave. I just need a moment.
dialogue.polen.ambient_timid.warm.line1: Sorry... sometimes I jump even when it is you.
dialogue.polen.ambient_timid.warm.line2: You know how I am. Just give me a moment.
dialogue.polen.ambient_timid.warm.line3: It is alright. I was only startled for a second.
dialogue.polen.ambient_unsafe.claustroph: The air feels too closed in here. I want out.
I cannot think well in a corner this tight.
I would rather be somewhere I can see a little farther.
dialogue.polen.ambient_unsafe.escaping.l: I do not want to freeze here. I just need a clear way out.
If I keep moving, I can still find a safe point.
I am not running blindly. I am looking for somewhere stable.
dialogue.polen.ambient_unsafe.guarded.li: I do not like this place...
It is too dark. I would rather leave.
I do not think we should stay down here.
dialogue.polen.ambient_unsafe.night.line: Night feels too open here. I need light or shelter.
If I do not find a safer corner soon, this will get worse.
Too much darkness and nothing covering me. I do not like it.
dialogue.polen.ambient_unsafe.rain.line1: The rain keeps pulling at my focus. I need cover.
dialogue.polen.ambient_unsafe.rain.line2: If I stay soaked like this, I will not think clearly.
dialogue.polen.ambient_unsafe.rain.line3: I need a real roof, even a small one.
dialogue.polen.ambient_unsafe.ranged.lin: I do not want to stay exposed. I need something to break their line of sight.
If I stay out in the open, they will reach me from far away.
I need a wall, a tree, anything between them and me.
dialogue.polen.ambient_unsafe.soft.line1: I do not feel calm here. I will look for a better place.
dialogue.polen.ambient_unsafe.soft.line2: The air feels too heavy here... we should go up.
dialogue.polen.ambient_unsafe.soft.line3: Cosmic used to joke even when everything went wrong. After the war, he learned to smile differently.
dialogue.polen.ambient_unsafe.warm.line1: Let us go somewhere a little higher, alright?
dialogue.polen.ambient_unsafe.warm.line2: I do not want to leave you. I just want to leave this place.
dialogue.polen.ambient_unsafe.warm.line3: I will feel better once we are somewhere open again.
dialogue.polen.chapter0.line3: Sorry... I don't usually talk to strangers.
dialogue.polen.chapter0.line4: This clearing is quiet. That's why I stayed.
dialogue.polen.chapter0.line5: Are you looking for somewhere safe too?
dialogue.polen.chapter1.line1: That place you're building... it looks safe.
dialogue.polen.chapter1.line2: I did not think I would feel calm around other people again... not after the university.
dialogue.polen.chapter1.line3: Maybe a small shelter is enough for now.
dialogue.polen.chapter1.line5: I studied healing magic with friends who believed every life in Hive mattered.
dialogue.polen.chapter1.line6: Befsh used to say I worried too much. She was usually right.
dialogue.polen.chapter1.line7: Some names are easier to carry in silence: Luna, Cosmic, Noia, Noris...
dialogue.polen.event.first_meeting.disco: You found an unknown girl in the clearing.
dialogue.polen.event.first_meeting.line2: She does not seem hostile... but this silence should not be broken too quickly.
dialogue.polen.event.name_reveal.line2: There is something I want to tell you.
dialogue.polen.event.name_reveal.line3: I don't know why... but I feel like I can trust you.
dialogue.polen.event.shelter.line2: It does not look like a palace, or a royal hive...
dialogue.polen.memory.first_colony: You're not building just to spend the night, are you?
dialogue.polen.memory.first_flower: These flowers... Befsh used to say they helped me breathe when everything became too loud.
dialogue.polen.memory.first_hive: Bees always find their way back. I like to think I might, too.
dialogue.polen.memory.first_residence: This place... it does not feel borrowed anymore. It reminds me that a shelter can also become a promise.
dialogue.polen.memory.first_source: That energy... I feel like I should recognize it.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.arrival.board.0: You found the board. Good. Read it before you wander underground.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.arrival.board.1: Back again? Fine. Means you are either serious or stubborn.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.arrival.board.2: Good timing. I could use someone who follows instructions.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.arrival.board.3: There you are. Easier to plan when the dependable one shows up.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.arrival.board.4: You are here. Good. I can skip the careful version.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.arrival.cave.0: You should not be down here without light and a clean way back.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.arrival.cave.1: Watch your footing. The cave punishes distracted people first.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.arrival.cave.2: Stay on my line and we will keep this simple.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.arrival.cave.3: Good. You know the rhythm. We move, we listen, we leave intact.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.arrival.cave.4: Glad it is you. This place is easier when I do not need to explain every step.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.attack_warning: Hit me again and you can mine alone.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.board_gift: You brought boards? Good. Dry timber matters more underground than most people think.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.encounter_end.boar: That is all for now. Come back when you want proper work.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.encounter_end.cave: We are done here. Get topside before the dark starts lying to you.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.0.1: If you want work, start by reading the board instead of guessing.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.0.2: A bad plan underground usually starts with someone being in a hurry.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.0.3: Take light, take food, take a way back. Then we talk.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.1.1: You came back. That already puts you ahead of most volunteers.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.1.2: Mining is not bravery. It is rhythm, patience, and leaving before greed wins.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.1.3: If you read the board twice, you usually make half as many mistakes.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.2.1: You learn fast when stone is the teacher.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.2.2: I trust you more with a lantern than most people with a sword.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.2.3: A steady hand saves more lives than loud courage.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.3.1: You know the routine now. Check the board, then check your own head.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.3.2: When you stay calm, the whole crew wastes less time recovering from mistakes.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.3.3: You are turning into someone I can actually plan around.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.4.1: If you are here, I can stop expecting the ground to surprise me twice.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.4.2: You know when to push and when to pull back. That is rare.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.board.4.3: Most people talk about trust. You make it practical.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.0.1: Keep your breathing slow. Panic turns tunnels smaller than they are.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.0.2: Listen to the rock before you swing. It usually warns you first.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.0.3: Do not drift out of lantern light unless you enjoy getting lost.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.1.1: Your footing is better today. Keep it that way.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.1.2: If the tunnel feels wrong, say it early. Pride is useless down here.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.1.3: A cave does not care whether your mistake was small.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.2.1: You are starting to move like someone who intends to come back alive.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.2.2: Good. You heard that crack before I did.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.2.3: Stay sharp. Comfort underground should never become laziness.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.3.1: You cover space well. Makes this work lighter.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.3.2: If the route breaks, you already know which way I want us out.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.3.3: That is the pace. No wasted swings, no wasted fear.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.4.1: I do not need to watch every step you take anymore.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.4.2: You make bad ground feel almost manageable.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.idle.cave.4.3: With you here, I can pay attention to the cave instead of the crew.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.mining_start: Stay close enough to see my lantern, far enough not to catch my swing.
If your torch is dying, say it before your courage does.
Supports first, ore second. People keep forgetting the correct order.
Read the notes. I wrote them to save us all time.
No rush. Rushed miners turn into stories.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.nearby.board_spawn: Board is up. If you want work, read before asking.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.nearby.cave_idle.1: Hear that? Hollow pocket in the wall. Keep clear.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.nearby.cave_idle.2: The tunnel bends left ahead. Do not fight it.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.nearby.cave_idle.3: Keep the floor in mind. Loose gravel tells on itself.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.nearby.cave_idle.4: If the air changes, we change plans.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.nearby.cave_spawn: Fresh vein ahead. Mind the loose stone.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.reward.coal: Take the coal. Better black hands than no fire.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.reward.diamond: A clean find. Do not waste it showing off.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.reward.lapis: Lapis. Useful if you know how to think with it.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.reward.torches: Take the torches. Darkness gets bold when people arrive unprepared.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.share_reward: You carried your part. Keep this and keep moving smart.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier0.line1: Name is Soa. If you need a mine explained, speak clearly.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier0.line2: I do not mind questions. I mind careless ones.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier0.line3: If you are here for depth, start by respecting the way back out.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier0.line4: Underground work is simple: keep your head, your light, and your timing.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier0.line5: Stand where I can see you. It saves time.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier1.line1: You listen better than most. That matters.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier1.line2: A mine is easier on people who do not argue with every warning.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier1.line3: Bring timber when you can. Everyone remembers the person who keeps the roof up.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier1.line4: If you want to help, learn the route before you learn the reward.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier1.line5: You are still green, but at least you are paying attention.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier2.line1: I can work with someone steady. You are getting there.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier2.line2: You do not flinch every time stone answers back anymore.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier2.line3: Most people chase ore. The better ones watch the space around it.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier2.line4: If I point at trouble, you move first and complain later. Good habit.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier2.line5: You are becoming useful in the way that keeps everyone alive.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier3.line1: I know what to expect from you now. That is worth a lot to me.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier3.line2: You keep a level head when the cave wants drama. Keep doing that.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier3.line3: A reliable partner makes a hard route feel shorter.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier3.line4: If something goes wrong, I trust you to notice before it becomes a collapse.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.tier3.line5: You have earned the right to hear my blunt version first.
dialogue.soa.marjorie.torch_place: There. Shadows get bold when no one argues with them.
item.hc_characters.polen_spawn_egg.alrea: Polen already exists in this world.
item.hc_characters.secondary_spawn_egg.d: Secondary NPC spawn eggs are disabled in hc-characters-common.toml.
message.polen.bee_bed.bind.no_access: Polen cannot reach this bed safely yet.
message.polen.bee_bed.bind.success: Polen now recognizes this bee bed as part of her refuge.
message.polen.block.bee_bed.reserved: This improvised bed belongs to Polen. Only she treats it as her refuge.
message.polen.gift.accepted_bees: Polen accepts the bee gift with careful warmth.
message.polen.gift.accepted_home: Polen seems calmer around something meant to make a place safer.
message.polen.gift.accepted_nature: Polen studies the natural gift as if it might remember her too.
message.polen.gift.accepted_source: A small thread of Source answers the gift.
message.polen.gift.cooldown: Polen needs a little time before another gift means something.
message.polen.gift.rejected: Polen draws back from that gift.
message.polen.item.bloom_focus.marked_fl: The focus helped Polen remember these flowers.
message.polen.item.bloom_focus.marked_hi: The focus resonated with a hive Polen can remember.
message.polen.item.bloom_focus.no_resona: There is nothing here for the focus to anchor.
message.polen.item.bloom_focus.resonated: A soft resonance stirred a memory tied to source.
message.polen.item.hiveheart_charm.dorma: The lead has already served its purpose. The sketch now remains as a record of the find.
message.polen.item.hiveheart_charm.guida: The sketch needle pulls %1$s. The place seems %2$s.
message.polen.item.hiveheart_charm.no_re: The sketch clue is incomplete or damaged. Polen's clearing could not be fixed in this world.
message.polen.item.residence_charm.inval: This place does not seem ready to become Polen's residence yet.
message.polen.item.residence_charm.marke: Polen will begin to recognize this shelter as a place she can return to.
Polen will begin to treat this place as a space of her own within the colony.
message.polen.item.residence_charm.needs: This place does not seem to have clear enough access to become her refuge.
For Polen to recognize it as hers, this place needs a nearby bed.
This still does not feel like a residence: it needs a real roof.
